name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: No unexplained cluster or novel pathogen under international investigation found by 23 Nov
state: UKHSA's outbreak report for the week to 15 Nov, published on 19 Nov, covers only known pathogens: Bundibugyo Ebola and two MERS-CoV cases in Qatar, the first there since 2022, and lists no novel or unexplained cluster (UKHSA). Searches from 20 to 23 Nov found no unexplained cluster under international investigation, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No action is needed. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice and the NHS Fit for Travel pages for current health risks at their destination.
